facts.text: Individual figures have a unique public URL at /share/fig/{shareToken}.
The charts table gains a share_token TEXT column (nullable, unique, indexed) for lazy share link generation.
Share tokens are generated lazily on first share action, using repository.NewID (16-char random).
GET /share/fig/{shareToken} serves a standalone page showing: original figure image, PaperViz explanation, source paper title, page number, reading level, and CTA to analyze own paper.
The original figure and PaperViz interpretation are visually distinguishable on the share page (e.g., labeled sections, distinct styling).
Figures inherit their parent document's visibility: public (share works), unlisted (share works, not in dashboard), private (share links return 404).
Document expiry (7-day inactivity) automatically invalidates all figure share links for that document.
Document owner can revoke sharing by clearing the share_token. Revoked tokens return 404.
Each ChartCard in the result page has a share button that opens a ShareDialog with the figure-specific share URL.
The existing document ShareDialog continues to share the document link. Figure sharing uses a separate per-chart share button.
The share page preserves provenance: source paper attribution and uncertainty information are shown alongside the explanation.
A new handler: POST /api/documents/{id}/charts/{chartId}/share generates or returns the share token. DELETE /api/documents/{id}/charts/{chartId}/share revokes it.
The frontend share page (ShareFigurePage) is a new route at /share/fig/:shareToken, rendered outside the auth-protected layout.
